reasoning_content: The host doesn't have python3. Instead, I'll write the patch script to /tmp and execute it inside the container.

action.command:
cat > /workspace/.build-logs/patch_frontend.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
p = sys.argv[1]
txt = open(p).read()
start = txt.index('RUN npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-fp &')
end = txt.index('wait', start)
end = txt.index('\n', end) + 1
new = (
"RUN set -e; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-fp mfe-kp; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-mp mfe-verwaltungsakt; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-vp mfe-ws; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-ewm; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    npm run build:release --workspace=shell\n"
)
open(p, 'w').write(txt[:start] + new + txt[end:])
print("patched", p)
PYEOF
docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm python3 /w/.build-logs/patch_frontend.py /w/.build-logs/stage-frontend/Dockerfile
grep -n 'RUN set -e' /workspace/.build-logs/stage-frontend/Dockerfile
